description: Conformance fixtures for K'UHUL Fold Algebra. Each case is an execution-ordered fold sequence plus the verdict the composition law must reach. Contract authority: data/grammar/kuhul-fold-algebra.contracts.json and data/grammar/kuhul-fold-algebra.ebnf.

legal.description: The six-fold cycle: Pop -> Wo -> Yax -> Sek -> Ch'en -> Xul. Structurally legal, five crossings, each still owed to XCFE.
The SRAI dispatch pipeline is legal end to end, because VERIFY stands between RANK and TRAIN.
Sek(C) = Rank(Filter(Map(C))). Inner operators are phase-agnostic, so this crosses no boundary at all.
The identity is the unit: composing it into a plan changes nothing but the elision list.
TRAIN reached through VERIFY, which is the only composition that satisfies the verification rule.
A single fold is a legal plan of length one and crosses nothing.
Two folds inside the same phase compose with no admission and no boundary.
A plan of identities only is the identity: legal, inert, and phase-free.

illegal.description: TRAIN fed straight from SCORE. The types chain, so this is exactly the case where only the verification rule saves it: raw rank alone does not authorize learning.
Running Xul before Sek traverses the cycle backwards.
Xul is the end of the cycle. Wrapping round to Pop inside one plan is a second traversal, not a longer composition.
A typed identity only elides where its carrier chains: a state identity does not carry a candidate set.
COLLAPSE produces one collapsed candidate; RANK consumes sets, not a single candidate.
